title: Additional requirements for conventional construction in Seismic Design Category B or C.
officialText:
Structures of
conventional light-frame construction in Seismic Design Category B or C, as determined in Section 1613, shall comply with Sections
2308.11.1 through 2308.11.3, in addition to the provisions of Sections 2308.1 through 2308.10.
